title: Commit Combobox
description: Stops a pick-from-list field saving text the user only typed, or a stale pick they typed over: unpicked text is matched on blur (an exact match is picked, a misspelling gets a one-tap Did you mean, two same-named options ask which), editing after a pick visibly drops it with Undo or Esc, and the stored option is always read back.
stops: Typed text saved instead of a pick
